'''''Golden Petals 3''''' was an abstract painting made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of three abstract paintings made by [[Boulo Siesi]] that were put on display at the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]].
